help.about: CyTrace — on-premises dependency risk report generator

arg.lang: Interface language (zh-TW | en-US; falls back to CYTRACE_LANG, then zh-TW)

run.target: Scan target (directory, container image tar, or filesystem)
run.fail_on: Exit with code 2 when a finding reaches this severity (critical | high | medium | low | negligible | unknown; case-insensitive)
run.cbom: Also inventory cryptographic assets (CBOM; off by default)
run.fail_on_quantum_vulnerable: Exit with code 2 if any asset is quantum-vulnerable; exit with code 1 if no CBOM result was obtained (requires --cbom)

batch.fail_on: Exit with code 2 when a finding reaches this severity (critical | high | medium | low | negligible | unknown; case-insensitive)
batch.cbom: Also inventory cryptographic assets (CBOM; off by default)
batch.fail_on_quantum_vulnerable: Exit with code 2 if any target has a quantum-vulnerable asset; exit with code 1 if any target has no CBOM result (requires --cbom)

scan.target: Scan target (directory, container image tar, or filesystem)
scan.cbom: Also inventory cryptographic assets (CBOM; off by default)
scan.spdx: Also write the SBOM in SPDX 2.3 format (sbom.spdx.json; off by default)

serve.data_dir: Data directory for jobs and report artifacts (default /data; or CYTRACE_DATA_DIR)
serve.tls_cert: TLS certificate PEM (paired with --tls-key; or CYTRACE_TLS_CERT)
serve.tls_key: TLS private key PEM (paired with --tls-cert; or CYTRACE_TLS_KEY)

health.bind: Address to check (same order as serve: --bind > CYTRACE_BIND > 127.0.0.1:8443)

cmd.run: One shot: generate SBOM → match vulnerabilities → write report (optionally --fail-on)
cmd.batch: Scan several targets, one report each; exits 2 if any target reaches --fail-on
cmd.scan: Only write sbom.cdx.json and grype.json (plus sbom.spdx.json with --spdx, cbom.cdx.json with --cbom)
cmd.report: Rebuild a report offline from an existing ScanResult JSON (audit review)
cmd.serve: Start the web service: sign-in console plus scan and report API
cmd.hash_password: Generate the admin password's argon2id PHC string offline (for CYTRACE_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH)
cmd.health: Service liveness check (TCP connect; for container HEALTHCHECK)
